```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
'%||%' <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
suppressWarnings(suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(yaml)))
pubs <- read_yaml("content/publications.yml")

# Keep only publications and working papers that have at least one "data" link
is_data_link <- function(lnk) {
  grepl("data|code|replication|readme|pairwise|patent-level|time-series", lnk$label %||% "", ignore.case = TRUE)
}
has_data_links <- function(p) {
  links <- p$links %||% list()
  any(vapply(links, is_data_link, logical(1)))
}
# Only include entries that have data links and an explicit data_order (order on Data page)
data_entries <- Filter(function(x) {
  (identical(x$type, "publication") || identical(x$type, "working_paper")) &&
    has_data_links(x) &&
    !is.null(x$data_order)
}, pubs)
data_entries <- data_entries[order(sapply(data_entries, function(p) p$data_order))]

html_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}
source("scripts/bibtex_helpers.R")
bib_dir <- "docs/assets/bib"
dir.create(bib_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
used_slugs <- character(0)

render_data_entry <- function(p, num) {
  is_wp <- identical(p$type, "working_paper")
  slug <- paper_to_slug(p, used_slugs, is_working_paper = is_wp)
  used_slugs <<- c(used_slugs, slug)
  bib_content <- paper_to_bibtex(p, slug, is_working_paper = is_wp)
  writeLines(bib_content, file.path(bib_dir, paste0(slug, ".bib")))

  # Title as plain text (no link)
  cat(sprintf("\n%s. <span class=\"pub-title\">%s</span>  \n", num, html_escape(p$title %||% "")))

  auths <- p$authors %||% list()
  if (length(auths) > 0) {
    parts <- vapply(auths, function(a) {
      if (nzchar(a$url %||% "")) {
        sprintf('[%s](%s)', html_escape(a$name), a$url)
      } else {
        html_escape(a$name)
      }
    }, character(1))
    cat(sprintf("   (*with %s*)  \n", paste(parts, collapse = ", ")))
  }

  # Only data-related links
  for (lnk in p$links %||% list()) {
    if (!is_data_link(lnk)) next
    text <- lnk$label
    if (nzchar(lnk$suffix %||% "")) text <- paste0(text, lnk$suffix)
    cat(sprintf("   [[%s](%s)]\n", text, lnk$url))
  }
  cat(sprintf("   [[Bibtex](%s/%s.bib)]\n", "assets/bib", slug))
  cat("\n")
}

for (i in seq_along(data_entries)) {
  render_data_entry(data_entries[[i]], i)
}
```
